jobs.description: Home Position: Adjunct Faculty - Undergraduate Studies Watertown Location: Watertown, SD Job Id: 223 # of Openings: 1 Position Information Mount Marty University, a Catholic and Benedictine institution in the Liberal Arts tradition, seeks applications on a continuous basis for a pool of qualified adjunct faculty to teach on our Watertown, SD campus. The number of positions varies each semester, depending upon the needs of the University. Hiring units will consult the adjunct pool when there is a need. High need courses include Theology and Philosophy. Salary: $745 per credit hour. jobs.title: Adjunct Instructor – Conditional Hire (All Disciplines)
jobs.description: Adjunct Instructor – Conditional Hire (All Disciplines) University of Sioux Falls | Sioux Falls, SD This posting is intended only for individuals who have been contacted by a USF department, area chair, director, or USF Human Resources and conditionally offered a part-time adjunct instructor role, contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, credential verification, and other onboarding documentation. The University of Sioux Falls is pleased to extend conditional adjunct teaching appointments to qualified individuals who have been invited (by USF) to teach a specific course or serve in an instructional capacity. Important Note: This job posting is not open to unsolicited applications. If you have not received a verbal offer to teach at USF, please do not submit materials to this posting. General Position Summary Adjunct instructors at USF are contracted on a term-by-term basis to teach on-ground or, in some cases, online courses. Teaching assignments are based on departmental needs and course availability. Requirements: Master’s degree in the appropriate field required; doctoral degree preferred Relevant teaching experience, preferably in a traditional university setting Commitment to academic excellence and the integration of faith and learning within a Christian liberal arts environment Must reside in South Dakota, or if residing outside of South Dakota adjunct must teach on-ground class(es) for USF Next Steps for Your Conditional Adjunct Instructor Offer: If a USF representative has asked you to complete this step, please watch your email for instructions and requests from USF HR/Payroll – USFpayroll@usiouxfalls.edu 1. Background Check You will receive an email from our third-party vendor (on behalf of USF HR/Payroll) with a link to complete your background check. The background check must be completed and returned to USF HR before you can begin teaching. 2. Submit Required Documents To help expedite the hiring process, please upload the following items as soon as possible (you may submit them while your background check is in progress): Letter of application outlining your qualifications and teaching interests Curriculum Vitae (CV) Statement of Christian faith Contact information for at least three professional references familiar with your teaching or academic work 3. Final Onboarding Once your background check, credential verification, and other employment documentation are complete and approved, you will receive additional onboarding materials from usfpayroll@usiouxfalls.edu via DocuSign, if required. The University of Sioux Falls is an Equal Opportunity, Affirmative Action Employer.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor of Art in Digital Media
jobs.description: Position Description The Art Department at Augustana University, a rigorous undergraduate-focused private liberal arts institution, invites applications for a full-time tenure-track faculty position in Digital Media beginning August 2027. The Augustana University Art Department is a NASAD-accredited BA and BFA degree-granting program with areas including studio art, design, art education, and Pre-Architecture. We seek a dynamic artist/designer/creative practitioner whose expertise centers on contemporary animation, motion graphics, digital compositing, rendering, immersive digital environments, and time-based media workflows. The ideal candidate will demonstrate fluency in current industry-standard software and digital production pipelines, along with strong visual storytelling, spatial thinking, and world-building sensibilities within an undergraduate liberal arts environment. The department is particularly interested in candidates whose practice emphasizes: Animation and motion graphics Digital compositing and visual storytelling Rendering and digital environment/world-building workflows 3D modeling and spatial visualization Time-based digital media Interactive and immersive media Familiarity with professional workflows related to cinematic visualization, immersive environments, virtual production, game environments, digital photography, or entertainment-oriented digital pipelines is welcome. This position is intended for candidates whose primary expertise is grounded in contemporary 3D and time-based digital media practices rather than traditional graphic design, experimental film/video, or studio photography-based practices alone. Preferred software proficiencies may include Maya, Blender, Rhino, Cinema 4D, After Effects, Unreal Engine, Twinmotion, Houdini, Substance 3D, Adobe Creative Suite, or comparable professional tools. Experience with real-time rendering environments, immersive visualization workflows, or spatially oriented digital production pipelines is welcome. Primary Responsibilities Teaching digital media studio courses for B.A. and B.F.A. art majors and non-majors Developing and expanding curriculum in digital media in collaboration with the Art Department and multimedia entrepreneurship program Maintaining an active record of creative scholarship and/or professional practice Advising undergraduate students Service to the department and university community The successful candidate will typically teach three courses per semester, including Digital Photography, Digital Media I, and Advanced Digital Media. Interim/J-term offerings may align with the candidate’s areas of expertise and specialization. The new hire will receive course-development release time during their first January term and will teach every two out of three January terms thereafter. Qualifications MFA in Digital Media, 3D Animation, Motion Design, Multimedia, Digital Visualization, Interactive Media, or a related field required. Professional or industry experience is strongly preferred, particularly in areas related to contemporary digital production, visualization, animation, immersive media, or professional digital content creation workflows. Previous college-level teaching experience is preferred. The successful candidate will demonstrate: Strong technical and conceptual fluency in contemporary digital media practices Commitment to innovative undergraduate teaching and mentorship Ability to teach both foundational and advanced digital workflows Evidence of strong design sensibilities and visual communication Interest in curriculum development and interdisciplinary collaboration Commitment to fostering an inclusive and supportive learning environment Appreciation for the liberal arts and student-centered education We especially encourage applicants whose work demonstrates excellence in digital visualization, spatial/world-building practices, animation, motion design, and technologically forward studio approaches. jobs.title: Assistant Professor, Business Management
jobs.description: Augustana University invites applications for the position of full-time Assistant Professor of Business Management. Tenure track position. Responsibilities: Teaches graduate and undergraduate courses and conducts research in the business and management disciplines with special focus on the areas of business, management, or administration. Develops and designs curriculum to foster student learning, stimulate class discussions, and encourage student engagement. Course offerings may be taught during the day, evening, or online, as well as taught using distance learning formats. Provides academic advising and assesses student outcomes. Provides intellectual leadership, conducts research, and makes contributions to the literature in the field of business. Engage in service to the department, university, and community Augustana prides itself on excellence in-person classroom instruction, thus the successful applicant will demonstrate a strong commitment to teaching and mentoring students in a liberal arts environment. Qualifications: A PhD or DBA in a qualifying academic major, including Business, Business Administration, Management, or Strategic Management. ABD candidates accepted. Candidates with a discipline specific business degree (finance, marketing) will also be considered. Post-secondary teaching experience and research accomplishment are preferred. Candidates with additional non-academic business experience are preferred. Interacting with students, faculty and leadership with different backgrounds and points of view and a deep appreciation of and respect for academic values and culture must be a top value of the candidate. If you are looking for a rewarding and dynamic career, look no further than Augustana University in Sioux Falls, SD. Augustana offers an excellent benefit package including health insurance, dental insurance, life insurance, AD&D, short- and long-term disability, retirement plan, tuition assistance, holiday, vacation and sick pay. Application Procedure: The position will remain open until filled. Interested applicants are asked to submit the below application materials via our Career Center Portal. If assistance is needed during the application process, please reach out to humanresources@augie.edu . cover letter statement of teaching philosophy copies of undergraduate and graduate transcripts a curriculum vita three letters of reference Augustana University is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action/Title IX Employer. Applicants must comply with the Immigration Reform and Control Act and may be required to submit official transcripts upon employment. Finalist candidates must satisfactorily complete a pre-employment background check.
